Triage: lands in `packages/spec` ⇒ **`domain:spec`**; **type `Bug`, `priority:p2`, `pm:blocked`.**

## `pm:blocked`, and the block is live — measured 2026-09-10T17:21:00Z

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| PR #17486 | **open, `draft=true`, `mergeable_state=blocked`** — not merged |
| #15942 | **open**, `pm:dispatched` to `os-justin`, `priority:p1`, `security`, `needs:contract-review` |

⇒ All three prescriptions are **TRUE today** — the runtime confirmation door has not shipped. They become false the moment #17486 merges. ⛔ Correcting them now would make the published text wrong in the other direction, and in the more dangerous direction: it would promise a pause that does not yet exist.

`Blocked-by: #15942` recorded on the body — the **issue**, not the PR, so the unlock scan can fire when it closes.

## ⭐ Why p2 rather than p3, unlike the other two docs-drift cards this fire

The other two mislead about a shape. This one will mislead about a **safety gate**, and the card names the direction precisely:

> they tell an author the safety flag stops nothing, so an author who reads them concludes the gate is inert and arranges a human in the loop some other way, or stops setting the flag at all.

⇒ An author who stops setting `requiresConfirmation` because the prose says it is inert **loses the gate** at the moment it starts working. And these are not comments — the first reaches consumers as a **parse-error prescription on a `.strict()` schema**, and the other two are what `spec-changes.json`, the upgrade guide and `os migrate meta` project. ⇒ Shipped text on a security-adjacent surface.

⭐ The card's own framing is the sharpest statement of the class and I am keeping it: #15942 was 「published prose promises a pause the runtime does not perform」; this is 「published prose denies a pause the runtime now performs」. **Same class, same surface, opposite sign.**

⚠️ ⛔ Not p1: nothing is wrong today, and #15942 — the p1 with `security` — is the card that carries the real exposure. This one is its residue and cannot bite until that one lands.

## On release

⚠️ Re-verify the three sites still read as quoted **on the merged ref** before dispatching — #17486 is a draft and its own diff may already correct one or more of them. ⇒ The card's premise is 「PR #17486 makes all three false」, and a dev must falsify that per-site rather than assume all three survive.

## 分诊:**解锁** —— `Blocked-by:` 的阻塞者已关,且本席在源上复核了「等的那件事真的到了」

分诊席,2026-09-18T14:06Z。⛔ 本席不认领、不派发;本笔只改状态,⛔ 不动 `domain:*` / `priority:*` / 类型标签。

### 本席现读

- 阻塞者 **#15942**(MCP `run_action` 执行 `ai.requiresConfirmation`,即那道运行时门):`state=closed` · `state_reason=completed`。
- ⭐ **前提今天为真,逐字读过**:`packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts` 在 `origin/main` 上仍写着「the declaration is the contract, **not yet the behaviour** — the runtime door that performs the refusal **ships separately, and until it does, setting the flag does NOT stop an unconfirmed** …」⇒ 这条**已发布**的规定现在**否认一道已经存在的门**,失效方向正是本卡点出的那个(作者据此认为 flag 无效,于是不设它)。

⇒ **`pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`**。⛔ 级别不动(p2 `domain:spec` `bug`)。⚠️ 本席只复核了三处站点中的**第一处**;另两处(`spec-changes.json` / 升级指南 / `os migrate meta` 投影)⛔ **未测** —— 接手者先把三处都现读一遍再动笔。

### ⚠️ 本次解锁扫描的口径与半径(⛔ 零与「已关」都要带半径)

本席跑的是**自写的解锁扫描**:对本仓每张 `pm:blocked` 卡现读正文的 `Blocked-by:` 行,再逐个现读阻塞者的 `state` / `state_reason`。
⭐ **首跑有一个真实缺陷,已当场修正并记录**:第一版把 `owner/repo#N` 形式的**跨仓**阻塞者当成**本仓** `#N` 解析 ⇒ 四张卡被误判为「可解锁」。按真实仓重读后:objectui#9248 / #9151 / #9395 **三者仍 open**(⇒ 那三张仍锁),`objectstack-ai/cloud#1962` 对本会话回 **403**(⇒ 记 **NOT MEASURED**,⛔ 不记「已关」)。
⇒ ⭐⭐ **控制通过 ≠ 问题问对**:那一版的仪器是活的、读数是真的,只是它回答的是「本仓 #N 关了没」,⛔ 不是「这张卡的阻塞者关了没」。
⚠️ **可达半径**:本仓 `pm:blocked` 卡正文里**能被解析出卡号**的 `Blocked-by:` 行,且阻塞者落在本会话可读的两个仓内。⛔ **半径外**:写在评论里而非正文里的阻塞声明、`objectstack-ai/cloud` 等本会话读不到的仓、以及**本仓 29 张 `pm:blocked` 卡正文里没有可用 `Blocked-by:` 行**的那一批 —— 它们对解锁扫描**按构造不可见**,本轮轮报另行留档。

## Why `Clause-②: no`

Nothing here moves an accept set or a published export surface. The three artefacts are **prose** that describes runtime behaviour, and the behaviour they describe already changed when #15942's door shipped. Feed the same authored metadata in before and after this card: accepted stays accepted, refused stays refused, not one byte moves. ⇒ 辅助面, and the second cut answers 「它误导了 AI 吗」 with **yes** — see below.

⚠️ `dispatch-gates --tier` flags `packages/spec/src/**` as a Clause-② SUSPECT surface. That is a floor, never a clearance, and this seat judges it from the card CONTENT: the diff is docblock and prose. If the taker finds it must move a schema, a default or an exported name to make the prose true, that is a different card's shape — **stop and report**, ⛔ do not re-declare the arm unilaterally.

## Why this card is picked, and why it is not a p2 the North Star bars

`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 「优先级」 item 3 bars p2/p3 **工具卡、契约卫生卡** while product P0/P1 are open. This is neither: it is the North Star's own item 4 — 「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」 — in its sharpest form. Three **published**, customer-facing prescriptions state in the present tense that the confirmation door has not shipped. It has. An author who reads them concludes the safety flag stops nothing and either arranges a human in the loop some other way or stops setting the flag. ⇒ the failure direction is the dangerous one, and the victim is the reader who believed the protocol.

## Tier derivation, quoted from this act's own run

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --tier packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts` (exit 0), verbatim:

> Model tier — no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 3 declared glob(s), derived here, not recalled.
> - packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts ⇢ 'packages/spec/src/**' — the contract surface (error-code ledger, *.zod.ts contract schemas) — the normal landing zone of a clause-② card

## ⚠️ What triage measured, and the half it did NOT

Triage's unblock (`5731153371`) verified **site 1 only**, reading `packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts` on `origin/main` and quoting it verbatim: 「the declaration is the contract, **not yet the behaviour** — the runtime door that performs the refusal **ships separately, and until it does, setting the flag does NOT stop an unconfirmed** …」. It wrote, in its own words, that the other two sites are ⛔ **未测**.

⇒ the taker re-reads **all three** on today's `origin/main` before writing a line, and reports any site whose text is already correct as NOT A DEFECT rather than editing it to match a prediction.

## What landed, and the correction the round produced

Three published prescriptions that denied a door that exists now state the refusal in the present tense — `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` (428), a GATE and not a queue, a refused call having read and written nothing.

⭐ **The implementer corrected this card's own count and it is worth recording:** the three prescriptions do not live in three files. They live in **two** — `packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts` and the ADR-0087 D3 entry — because the `spec-changes` entry, the upgrade guide and the `os migrate meta` projection are three **generated projections** of that one entry. The reviewer verified the projection chain structurally. Two further sites were read and left alone as **NOT A DEFECT** (`contracts/ai-service.ts` already normative; `content/docs/ai/tools.mdx` speaks of the retired tool-level key).

## ⭐ The reason this round needed a contract review even at `Clause-②: no`

The fix's own failure mode is this card's defect with the sign flipped: prose claiming **more** protection than the door delivers. The shipped text therefore states the door's two BOUNDS — the enforced set is the `ai.exposed` doors (today the action door reached from MCP `run_action`, with REST `/actions` **outside** it), and `confirm: true` is an unverifiable caller claim, so *「the gate makes FORGETTING loud, it does not prove a human」*. The reviewer re-derived every claim against `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` and confirmed the gate sits before `loadActionSubjectRecord`, that the REST door is ungated, and that only the boolean `true` confirms.

Review of record: PR #19234 comment `5747239069` — `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, **VERDICT: PASS**, no blocking findings. It ran **four** ablation legs itself, one of them (`ENFORCED` → `DECLARED, not yet performed`) on a carrier the implementer had not ablated.

`Clause-②: no` held on measurement: ten authored inputs fed through the base and head builds give identical structural outcomes; `authorable-surface/` and `api-surface/` are absent from the diff because nothing moved, and `check:generated` is green.

## Carried out of this round with no card

Two of the review's noted findings are card-shaped and have no issue number: `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`'s human-in-the-loop section omits the server-side refusal, and `packages/spec/docs/MCP_GUIDE.md` §3 pairs an approval-queue requirement with 「nothing server-side pauses on it」. ⚠️ With the four already carried from the #17987 round, **six findings now have no carrier** — this seat cannot open issues in this session, and the gap is on the maintainer's desk.
